theme: An open day with the girls in St. Pete — the last clear runway before Croatia.
greeting: No meetings on the calendar today; Conor Kehoe's PRI call came off. The girls are with you and Mike in St. Pete, and Croatia is four days out with a stack of P1 bookings still open — this is the day to close them.

needsAttention.title: Book the last Croatia night in Cavtat
needsAttention.detail: Open on your Mike + Dan board since Aug 23: the Sept 19 hotel and the noon marina transfer from ACI Komolac — bookable only from dry land, so it has to happen before you fly Sept 8.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags in writing
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags on both Eurowings Discover legs. Confirm the allowance on the operating carrier's site now, not at a European counter.

needsAttention.title: Lock the St. Pete landing-gap nights
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sept 20 but the girls aren't picked up until the 22nd — the nights of Sept 20 and 21 still have no room.

needsAttention.title: Decide the Sept 20–Oct 5 rental car
needsAttention.detail: A P2 with a Sept 7 decision point: hold a refundable full-size SUV as backup unless Mike's car is confirmed heading south.

flagged.title: New Morgan Stanley payee added
flagged.detail: At 8:14 AM, Morgan Stanley says a payee — 'J&B Drywall' — was added to your Payments service. Verify you did that; if not, act on it today.

flagged.title: New Google + OpenAI sign-ins
flagged.detail: New sign-ins to your Google and OpenAI accounts from St. Petersburg on Sept 3 — they look like you, so dismiss if so.

flagged.title: Two caregivers applied on Care.com
flagged.detail: Gabriella R. and Megan T. applied to the caregiver job you posted.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promos — NYT Cooking, Responsible Investor, Italian Word of the Day, Amex, Starbucks, and the usual retail.
inbox.clear: No recruiter or board mail today, and nothing awaiting your reply.

resolved: Conor Kehoe's office cancelled today's 10 AM EDT Zoom on PRI sustainability and stewardship — the calendar reads clear as a result.

recipe.title: Roasted kabocha squash
recipe.why: Early autumn brings the first hard squashes to market — roasting concentrates their sweetness.

tasks.title: Buy EU plug adapters and a power strip

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar — a rare, fully open stretch to spend on what's been waiting.
The day stays clear straight through; no meeting bookends it.
The girls are home with you in St. Pete — an easy evening in.
